C1183.title: Microsoft Urgently Removes Nearly 100 Poisoned Open-Source Repositories
C1183.summary: Microsoft closed 73 of its own GitHub repositories, including Azure Functions, Durable Task, and AI sample applications. The attack may be related to TeamPCP poisoning activity; researchers said attackers used a compromised contributor account to push malicious commits to Azure/durabletask, which could steal user credentials when opened in AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Gemini CLI. TeamPCP had previously released three malicious versions affecting hundreds of organizations.
